3605-3680-4808-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Stunt Double by paying {3}{U}, causing it to enter as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

574-4550-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
574-4550-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Repeat.
574-4550-5567-8298--112.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

2317-5478-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
2317-5478-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4687-4893-6723.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
4687-4893-6723.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1170-2146-5131-5226--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cloud Key has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2146-5131-5226--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cloud Key.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

1170-2146-5131-5330--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cloud Key has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2146-5131-5330--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cloud Key.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

4377-4823-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Timeless Witness.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Timeless Witness from exile to the battlefield.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1580-3967-4871-6887.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

457-1010-1409-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Prototype by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Prototype leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counters due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Prototype
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Prototype when it left the battlefield.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Prototype and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1010-1409-7306.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6730-6972.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-6730-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the additional creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As Sin enters, remove the -1/-1 counter from the creature sacrificed in step 1, causing Sin to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
When Sin enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the second Sin trigger, putting the counters it had on it when it was sacrificed onto a creature you control and failing to shuffle it into your library as it's no longer in your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5
Repeat.

1069-1374-5499-7175--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-5499-7175--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

2757-3887-5094-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five permanent cards in your graveyard.
2757-3887-5094-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {4}{B}, creating a creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping The Core.
Repeat.

5147-7083-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Baloth Prime trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Baloth Prime trigger, untapping it and creating a tapped 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

56-5695-6797.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Repeat from step 3.

1429-2292-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2292-5402-5929.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1247-1526-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Circle of Dreams Druid and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-1526-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Circle of Dreams Druid's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1750-2793-5131-5226-5261.description:
Activate Lithatog's first ability by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1144-1284-2178-3510.notablePrerequisites: Viridian Longbow and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature you control without summoning sickness.
1144-1284-2178-3510.description:
Whenever a land enters the battlefield, it enters as a 1/1 creature due to Yavimaya and Life and Limb.
Activate the creature with Viridian Longbow and Thornbite Staff attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the land.
The land dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The creature triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat as desired for each land an opponent controls, and whenever a land enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1864-4050-4772.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1864-4050-4772.description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a number of 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep creature tokens equal to twice the amount of mana spent to cast Prossh.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Prossh and two Kobolds, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Choose to return Prossh to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Kobold, adding {1}.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3684-5078.description:
Cast Supplant Form by paying {4}{U}{U}, targeting Birgi.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Supplant Form, returning Birgi from the battlefield to your hand and creating a token copy of Birgi.
Cast Birgi as Harnfel, Horn of Bounty by paying {4}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library from the battlefield.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-3015-4215.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing God-Eternal Rhonas, adding {C}{C}.
God-Eternal Rhonas dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the God-Eternal Rhonas trigger, putting it into your library third from the top.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for God-Eternal Rhonas, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
God-Eternal Rhonas enters the battlefield, doubling the power of each other creature you control and giving them vigilance until end of turn.
Repeat.
